columns.name: AppId
columns.description: Identifier of the parent app associated with this deployment.

columns.name: DeploymentName
columns.description: Display name of the app deployment.

columns.name: Enabled
columns.description: Whether the deployment is enabled for use.

columns.name: CreatedDate
columns.description: Timestamp when the deployment record was created (UTC).

columns.name: CreatedBy
columns.description: Identifier for the user who created the deployment record.

columns.name: LastUpdatedDate
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent update operation for this deployment (UTC).

columns.name: LastUpdatedBy
columns.description: Identifier for the user who performed the most recent action on the deployment.

columns.name: OuAvailabilitySetId
columns.description: Org Unit availability set identifier, which determines what organizational units the deployment is available to.

columns.name: DateDeleted
columns.description: Date and time when the deployment was deleted (UTC). Field can be null.

columns.name: LastModified
columns.description: Date when the deployment was last modified (UTC).
